set.body:
Remove universal/deep equality and implement explicit sampling relations plus zero-copy rebind.

Required relations
- sameRuntimeSpaceAs.
- samePersistentSpaceAs, with an explicit result for ephemeral spaces.
- exact pointwise sampling alignment.
- approximate geometric congruence with caller tolerance.
- any unit-conversion relation needed for non-spatial coordinates.
- sharesStorageWith when Ravel can prove it.
- sameValuesAs using caller-supplied equality.
- numeric allClose in a numeric/laws extension.

Design requirements
- SampleSpace, Sampled, Grid, and large image values use reference identity for Scala equals/hashCode unless a smaller immutable key type has structural equality.
- Compatibility is operation-specific; do not add one vague compatible predicate.
- Checked SamplingAlignment evidence is reusable so aligned operations do not repeat validation.
- Sampled.rebind transports a complete image across valid frame/grid/sample-space restoration evidence without copying immutable data.
- Metadata labels never control sampling compatibility.

Acceptance criteria
- Pointwise operations cannot proceed across unrelated spaces.
- Same-owner operations are total.
- Exact congruence between distinct keys is distinguishable from persistent identity.
- Approximate checks never happen without an explicit tolerance.
- Hashing a large image is O(1) in sample count.

Tests
- Complete relation matrix covering live owner, restored owner, equal geometry/different key, approximate geometry, unit mismatch, convention mismatch, axis-coordinate mismatch, and descriptive-label changes.
- HashMap regression on a representative 4D image proves no element traversal.
- NaN, signed zero, and approximate-result comparisons exist only in explicitly named value relations.
- Alignment identity, reverse, and composition laws.
- Rebind round trip preserves geometry/axes/metadata, shares immutable storage, and allocates no whole-image buffer.
- aligned zipWith agrees pointwise and reuses one checked alignment.
- JVM/Scala.js parity.
set.title: Replace universal equality with explicit sampling alignment and rebind
